Perfect! I've fixed the issue. The problem was that your FastAPI application was missing **CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing)** middleware. 

## What I changed:

1. **Added the CORS import**: `from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware`

2. **Added CORS middleware** to your FastAPI app with permissive settings that allow:
   - All origins (`allow_origins=["*"]`)
   - All HTTP methods (`allow_methods=["*"]`)
   - All headers (`allow_headers=["*"]`)
   - Credentials (`allow_credentials=True`)

## Why this fixes the issue:

When Stremio (running in a web browser or as a desktop app) tries to fetch your manifest from `https://stremio-musor-tv.onrender.com/manifest.json`, the browser's security policy blocks the request because:
- The request originates from a different domain (Stremio's domain)
- Your server wasn't sending CORS headers to allow cross-origin requests

With CORS middleware in place, your server will now include the proper headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, etc.) in responses, allowing Stremio to successfully fetch the manifest.
